name: N,N-Dimethyl-9-decenamide
description: N,N-Dimethyl-9-decenamide (CAS 1356964-77-6 ) is a bio-based fatty acid amide used as a solvent, wetting agent, and degreasing component across agricultural, cleaning, and personal care formulations. Its unsaturated C10 amide structure positions it as a functional alternative to conventional synthetic solvents in performance-driven applications. In agricultural formulations, it functions as a carrier and penetration enhancer. This material improves the delivery of active ingredients through plant surfaces in spray concentrates and adjuvant blends. Home care and industrial cleaning products incorporate it for its degreasing and surface-wetting performance. It is particularly effective in hard-surface cleaners and industrial degreasers where low residue and biodegradability are purchasing criteria. Personal care formulators use it as an emollient carrier and surface modifier. In rinse-off and leave-on systems, it enhances skin feel and spreadability to affect product differentiation. Its bio-derived origin supports formulation strategies targeting renewable content claims across all three sectors. N,N-Dimethyl-9-decenamide is supplied as a liquid. It is available in technical grade suitable for industrial and agricultural applications, with cosmetic-grade material accessible for personal care use. Packaging typically ranges from drums to intermediate bulk containers depending on order volume.
